author: Gmelin, 1789
summary: 봄과 가을에 해마다 수천 마리가 한반도를 지나가는 나그네새이다. 소나무나 일본잎갈나무 숲에 둥지를 틀고, 여름에는 암수가 함께 지내며 6~7월에 알을 4~6개, 흔히 4개 낳는다. 곤충, 복족류, 다족류 등을 주로 먹고 장미과 열매도 즐긴다. 동북아시아에 분포하며 중국 남부와 동남아시아 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.ko: 잿빛 띤 어두운 올리브 갈색 머리꼭대기(수컷)
황색 기 도는 녹슨 갈색 가슴과 옆구리

sexes.male: 머리꼭대기가 잿빛을 띤 어두운 올리브 갈색으로 깃 중앙이 거무스름하다.
sexes.female: 머리꼭대기와 뒷목이 등과 같은 올리브 갈색이고 깃 중앙만 조금 어둡다. 가슴과 옆구리의 녹슨 갈색이 수컷보다 조금 엷다.

art.subject: Eyebrowed Thrush (Turdus obscurus), adult male on spring passage (late April–May): head, neck and throat grey, the crown greyish with an olive-brown tinge and darker feather centres; a bold white supercilium; dark lores; a white crescent below the eye; back, wings and tail plain olive-brown; breast and flanks rich yellowish rusty-orange; centre of the belly and undertail coverts white; bill yellow-orange with a dark culmen and a dark tip; brown eye; yellowish-brown to pale orange-brown legs.
art.pose: perched on a pine branch, side view
art.scene: Korean pine and larch woods in early May, the larches in fresh pale-green needles, soft morning light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: grey head and throat, bold white supercilium, white crescent below the eye, olive-brown back, wings and square tail, rusty-orange breast and flanks, white belly, yellowish legs
adult female, side view perched: crown and nape olive-brown like the back, white supercilium, whitish throat with dark streaks at the sides, paler rusty-orange breast and flanks, white belly
art.build: Medium-sized thrush, about 22cm — much larger than a sparrow, a little shorter than a Brown-eared Bulbul but plumper. Rounded head with no crest and a straight, medium-length bill shorter than the head. Legs medium length, yellowish-brown to pale orange-brown. Wings fairly long and pointed. Tail medium-length and square-ended, plain, without white corners. Feeds on the ground and in fruiting trees; perches upright in the canopy, often in small flocks on passage.
avoid: Do not omit the bold white supercilium; it is the mark in both its Korean and English names.
Do not paint orange over the whole underside; the belly and vent are white.
Do not spot or streak the breast like Dusky or Naumann's Thrush.
Do not add white tail corners (Pale Thrush, Turdus pallidus).
